capabilities: Render the vault as an animated galaxy sized and orbited by link counts
Drag nodes to disturb linked neighbors with spring physics
Hover a note to highlight its links and neighbor names, click to open it
Switch between galaxy mode and per-folder cluster (expand) mode
Tune gravity, rotation, node size, colors and link display in a settings panel
extras: Marked in the manifest as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; until a community store listing, install is manual file copy or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows links as a static diagram, with no animated, explorable sense of hierarchy or which notes are central.
summary: Graph visualization that renders the vault as an animated galaxy where suns, hubs and orbiting notes mirror the real link structure.
